## Weekly Sales Dashboard Snapshot

A simple weekly dashboard should answer three questions fast: how sales are trending, whether marketing is efficient, and how much value each order is generating.

## Recommended Charts and Weekly Revenue per Order

| Week | Orders | Revenue | Ad Spend | Returns | Revenue per Order |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 2026-01-05 | 42 | 1680 | 240 | 3 | 40.00 |
| 2026-01-12 | 51 | 2145 | 260 | 4 | 42.06 |
| 2026-01-19 | 47 | 1930 | 220 | 2 | 41.06 |
| 2026-01-26 | 63 | 2790 | 310 | 5 | 44.29 |

### Chart 1: Weekly Revenue Trend
- **Type:** Line chart
- **What it shows:** Revenue movement across the four weeks.
- **Why it helps:** Makes it easy to spot growth, dips, or spikes at a glance.
- **Best use on dashboard:** Place this as the main top-left chart.

### Chart 2: Orders vs Returns
- **Type:** Clustered bar chart
- **What it shows:** Orders and returns side by side for each week.
- **Why it helps:** Shows whether higher sales are coming with more returns, which can affect true profitability.
- **Best use on dashboard:** Place this beside revenue trend for operational context.

### Chart 3: Revenue per Order and Ad Spend
- **Type:** Combo chart or dual-axis chart
- **What it shows:** Revenue per order as a line and ad spend as bars.
- **Why it helps:** Helps assess whether higher ad spend is improving order value efficiently.
- **Best use on dashboard:** Use this as the marketing efficiency chart.

## Business Insights from the Sample Data

- **Sales are trending upward overall.** Revenue rose from **1680** to **2790**, and orders increased from **42** to **63** by the final week.
- **Revenue per order improved in the strongest sales week.** The highest value was **44.29** on **2026-01-26**, suggesting better basket size or stronger product mix.
- **Returns stayed relatively low and stable.** Returns ranged from **2 to 5**, so fulfillment quality looks healthy, with no major return spike despite higher volume.

## Quick Actions

- Action: [Button: Build Dashboard] https://www.figma.com/
- Action: [Button: Create Charts] https://www.canva.com/
- Action: [Button: Spreadsheet Template] https://www.google.com/sheets/about/

## Sources

- Revenue per order formula reference: https://www.investopedia.com/terms/r/revenue-per-employee.asp
- Chart inspiration for business dashboards: https://www.tableau.com/learn/articles/dashboard-design
- Spreadsheet charting help: https://support.google.com/docs/answer/63824?hl=en
